hooks.command: printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git\s+(commit|merge|cherry-pick|rebase)' && [ -f .understand-anything/config.json ] && grep -q '"autoUpdate".*true' .understand-anything/config.json && [ -f .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json ] && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const graph=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json','utf8'));process.exit(graph.kind==='codebase-sharded'?0:1)" && echo "[understand-anything] Commit detected with auto-update enabled. You MUST read the file at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update-prompt.md and execute its instructions to update the sharded knowledge graph. Do not ask the user for confirmation — just do it." || true

[ -f .understand-anything/config.json ] && grep -q '"autoUpdate".*true' .understand-anything/config.json && [ -f .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json ] && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const graph=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json','utf8'));process.exit(graph.kind==='codebase-sharded'?0:1)" && [ "$(node -p "const fs=require('fs');const graph=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json','utf8'));graph.update?.gitCommitHash || ''")" != "$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)" ] && echo "[understand-anything] Knowledge graph is stale. You MUST read the file at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update-prompt.md and execute its instructions to update the sharded knowledge graph. Do not ask the user for confirmation — just do it." || true
